readerContract.humanQuestion: If I already use HoneyBook, what can this ChatGPT connection see and do, and what still waits for me?
readerContract.promisedPayoff: Ask account-grounded questions and prepare specific work while understanding the resource and approval boundaries.
readerContract.priorKnowledge: No knowledge of plugins, integrations or HoneyBook workflow is assumed.
readerContract.centralMentalModel: Selected HoneyBook records may be read; proposed work remains a draft until the user reviews and approves it.
readerContract.dailyLifeConnection: A small-business owner wants to check client work and prepare a next step without giving up the decision to change or send it.
readerContract.surfaceJob: A concise September 12 explanation of HoneyBook’s September 9 plugin announcement.
readerContract.desiredFeeling: I know what the HoneyBook connection can reach and where I still decide.

candidateRepairPreflight.datedChange: September 9 is the announcement date; “Yesterday” describes collection selection and is not used as a launch date.
candidateRepairPreflight.accountScope: Only selected HoneyBook resources are described.
candidateRepairPreflight.draftBoundary: Prepared work stays in draft until review and approval.

draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: HoneyBook users can ask ChatGPT about selected client-work records and prepare drafts that wait for review and approval.
causalSequence: The user connects a HoneyBook account and approves resources.
ChatGPT can answer from those records or prepare a stated draft.
The user reviews and approves before a change or client message happens.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: Ask which payments are overdue or prepare a proposal from a saved template.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: For another connected service, separate what the connection can read from what it can change or send.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Check the selected HoneyBook resources and review the draft before approval.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: The Story; The LAiDIES Read; What This Means for You; Cocktail Party; Class Notes.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Use HoneyBook’s stated records, draft gate and disconnect control; no generic plugin claim or small-business tips.
